fact: The nearest lone white dwarf — the burnt-out, Earth-sized ember of a dead star.
bio: Van Maanen's Star is a white dwarf about 14 light-years away in Pisces, the closest solitary white dwarf to the Sun. Once a Sun-like star, it has exhausted its fuel and collapsed to roughly the size of Earth, now slowly cooling as a dense stellar cinder.
cultural: It is named for Adriaan van Maanen, who discovered it in 1917. Its spectrum shows heavy elements that betray rocky debris raining onto it — early evidence that planetary systems can outlive their stars.
